narrative.overview: ASAP is designed as a high-density, professional utility. The aesthetic is institutional and dependable, signifying the system's role as a public utility.
keyCharacteristics: Institutional Trust: Solid deep blues and crisp neutrals.
Tactile Confidence: Clear boundaries and intentional shadows.

rules.name: The Authority Rule
rules.body: Civic Blue is reserved for meaningful actions and identity.

rules.name: The Shadow-of-State Rule
rules.body: Shadows respond to interaction, never a decorative default.

dos: Do use Roboto for all text.
Do keep information density high in staff views.
Do ensure 4px border-radius on interactive elements.
donts: Don't use overly round or 'bubbly' UI components.
Don't use neon or high-chroma accent colors.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe.
